new_commodity_proposals.evidence: The board answers this phrase with deli-ham (7 of 7), which is sliced sandwich meat sold by the half pound - a different product and a much higher price per pound than a whole bone-in spiral-sliced ham sold at 7-9 lb. The vocabulary's other ham row, diced-ham, is a diced convenience pack, also a different price class. Searched by food and not by string: neither a lunch-meat id nor a diced id can carry a whole holiday ham. If the estate already prices whole hams under a spelling such as 'ham' or 'bone-in-ham', alias there instead.

registrar_rulings.reason: No namespace prices a whole ham: recipe-board-everyday.json has zero 'ham' rows (re-verified with Select-String after an empty grep), recipe-commodities.json's only 'ham' strings are excludes in brown-sugar/honey, and commodities.json's deli-ham explicitly EXCLUDES 'spiral', '\bwhole\b', 'bone-?in' and 'glaze' - the estate already ruled spiral hams out of that id, so aliasing there would price a product its rules refuse. diced-ham is a diced pack at $0.31/oz, a different form and price class. The live feed has no spiral/bone-in product anywhere and deli-ham's crown is a Smithfield Portion Ham at $0.1238/oz, not a spiral ham. Mint spiral-ham in the recipe-only namespace (recipe-board baseline + recipe-commodities.json, since holiday hams go on sale), unit oz with variable-weight-capable capture. Prescribed include: 'spiral(?:[\s-]?(?:cut|sliced))?\s+ham', '(?:bone[\s-]?in|half|whole)\s+ham' with a full-rigor exclude list modeled on deli-ham's (~150 patterns: lunch meat/sliced/deli, diced/cubed, ham salad, glaze packets sold alone, graham, hamburger, hock, steak, pet/beverage/household noise). Follow-up edits for the caller: add the row via add-commodity-rule.ps1, and add commodity-dupe-allowlist.json pairs spiral-ham|deli-ham ('whole bone-in spiral ham vs sliced deli sandwich meat - same food, different purchase; deli-ham excludes spiral by rule') and spiral-ham|diced-ham ('whole ham vs diced convenience pack') so audit-commodity-dupes.ps1 never re-flags the trio. Vocabulary answer, kept separate from the id ruling: 'spiral ham' needs a new ingredients.json name row (nearest row diced-ham is a different form; no macros row exists - transcribe a label; fdc:168340/168341 spiral-slice ham entries are plausible macro sources).

macro_cross_check.detail: Totals at source scale over all 8 lines: 5246 cal, 681 g protein, 179 g carbs, 12 servings. Protein matches the source to within half a percent, which confirms the 8 lb midpoint I took for the '7-9 pounds' range is the right portion. Calories run 37% under the source's 690, entirely on the ham row basis: ours is the unheated lean-and-fat spiral-slice figure (129 cal/100 g) while the source's number implies a fattier or glazed-and-heated basis. Worth noting for whoever reads the cost side: the 3629 g is the ham's gross bone-in weight, while the FDC row is a boneless slice basis, so if anything our macros overstate the edible meat, not understate it. 437 cal / 15 g carbs is inside this run's conditions.
